This page collects selected notes, expository writings, and lecture-style materials.

## Notes

- [Allard Regularity Theorem Notes/ Allard正则性定理笔记](files/Allard-regularity-theorem-notes-v1.pdf)  
  Date: 2026-06-03.  
  Notes on Allard's regularity theorem, including its statement, geometric meaning, main assumptions, and its role in the regularity theory of varifolds. It might be simplified in the future. 

- [Elliptic PDE Regularity Notes/二阶椭圆PDE的正则性笔记, Chinese Version](files/elliptic-PDE-regularity-notes-CNver-v1.pdf)  
  Date: 2026-06-04.  
  Notes in Chinese on regularity theory for second-order elliptic partial differential equations, including basic estimates and related analytical tools. This is a really long note, and it is better to use it with Han-Lin or Gilbarg-Trudinger.

- [Yau Competition Geometry and Topology Notes/丘赛几何与拓扑复习笔记, Chinese Version](files/Yau-geometry-notes-CNver-v1.pdf)  
  Date: 2026-06-03.  
  Notes in Chinese for reviewing geometry and topology topics in the Yau Mathematical Sciences Competition, including selected definitions, theorems, examples, and problem-solving techniques. It should be noted that it does not include "Spectral Sequences", which requires many diagrams. 

- [Regularity of Minimal Surface Equations/极小曲面方程的正则性](files/minimal-surface-equation-regularity-notes-v1.pdf)  
  Date: 2026-06-03.  
  A short version for geometric analysts to understand the regularity theory quickly, including 4 steps of improvement of regularity. It can be regarded as a short version of the regularity theory for elliptic PDEs as well.
